loadErrorTitle: We could not load your setup
errorGeneric: Something went wrong on our side. Wait a moment, then try again.
planMissing: Choose a plan before we can schedule your prompts. Go back to pricing, pick Lite, Standard, Premium, or Enterprise, and enter how many prompts to run each day. The number cannot pass that plan’s maximum.
planSaved: We will run {prompts} prompts each day on {plan}. The first 7 days are a trial of that plan. After 7 days that plan is billed. We are not charging cards yet.
modeTitle: Are we tracking your own brand, or your clients?
modeTitleDomain: Are we tracking {domain}, or your clients?
modeBody: We shape your workspace around the one you pick.
domainTitleAgency: Which client site should we track?
domainBody: We read it to draft your topics and prompts.
domainChecking: Checking that the site is online…
domainEmpty: Enter the website address you want to track, for example example.com.
domainInvalid: “{value}” is not a website address. Enter a domain such as example.com, with no spaces.
domainUnreachable: We could not open {domain}. Check the spelling, make sure the site is live and public, then try again.
domainTaken: {domain} is already tracked in another workspace. Ask that workspace’s owner to invite you, or enter a different site.
nameTitle: What should we call your brand?
nameTitleAgency: What should we call your client?
nameBody: The name buyers use, not the legal entity.
nameEmpty: Enter the brand name. We look for this name in AI answers.
nameTooLong: Keep the brand name to 60 characters or fewer.
locationsTitle: Where should we run your prompts?
locationsBody: The country engines answer from, not your office.
locationsLimit: You can add up to {max} locations. Remove one before adding another.
locationsDuplicate: You added {country} in {language} twice. Change or remove one of them.
profileReadingBody: We pull a description, category, products, and personas from your site. This can take up to a minute.
profileBody: We pulled this info from your site. You can change it now or update it later from project settings.
profileBodyManual: Tell us about your brand. You can update this later from project settings.
profilePreviewNote: Preview mode cannot read your site. Fill in each field yourself.
profileDescriptionHint: What your brand does, in a sentence or two.
profileDescriptionHelp: We use this to write prompts that match what you sell.
profileDescriptionPlaceholder: For example: Software that schedules short videos across YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram.
profileDescriptionEmpty: Add a description. One or two sentences about what you do is enough.
profileDescriptionLong: Shorten the description to {max} characters. It is {count} now.
profileCategoryHint: The specific niche your brand competes in, not a broad industry.
profileCategoryHelp: Buyers ask AI about a category, such as “video production software”. We use it to find your competitors.
profileCategoryEmpty: Add a category, such as “Video production software”.
profileIdentityHelp: Optional. We check whether AI answers describe you this way.
profileProductsHelp: Each product can become a topic, with its own prompts.
profileProductsEmpty: Add at least one product or service. Press Add, type it, then press Enter.
profilePersonasHelp: We write prompts the way these buyers would ask them.
profilePersonasEmpty: Add at least one persona, such as “agency owner”. Press Add, type it, then press Enter.
profileFix: {count, plural, one {Fix the field marked in red, then press Looks good.} other {Fix the # fields marked in red, then press Looks good.}}
marketBody: Choose the markets that matter most to you.

marketPlaces.continent: Which continents? Press Add, type a name such as Europe, then press Enter.
marketPlaces.country: Which countries? Press Add, type a name such as Germany, then press Enter.
marketPlaces.state: Which states or provinces? Press Add, type a name such as California, then press Enter.
marketPlaces.city: Which cities? Press Add, type a name such as London, then press Enter.
marketPlaces.neighborhood: Which neighborhoods? Press Add, type a name such as Brooklyn, then press Enter.

marketPlacesEmpty: Add at least one {scope, select, continent {continent} country {country} state {state or province} city {city} other {neighborhood}}, or choose Global.
topicsBody: Remove any that do not fit your brand, or add your own.
topicsNone: Keep at least one topic. We group your prompts by topic.
topicTooLong: Keep the topic name to 60 characters or fewer.
topicLimit: You can have up to {max} topics. Remove one before adding another.
focusTitle: What should your prompts focus on?
focusBody: We’ll include a mix of questions, with more emphasis on your selection.

focus.researchBody: More emphasis on exploring problems and solutions.
focus.compareBody: More emphasis on comparisons and recommendations.
focus.actionBody: More emphasis on buying, booking, or signing up.

focusBrandingHint: How many prompts name a brand.
focusIntentHint: Where buyers are in their journey.
promptsGeneratingBody: We write about 100 prompts across your topics. This can take a few minutes. Keep this tab open.
promptsReviewBody: {count, plural, one {# prompt is ready for {name}. Continue saves it in All prompts. Check up to {limit} if you want that one to run each day.} other {# prompts are ready for {name}. Continue saves all of them in All prompts. Check up to {limit} if you want those to run each day.}}
promptsReviewBodyShort: {count, plural, one {# prompt is ready. Continue saves it in All prompts. Check up to {limit} if you want it to run each day.} other {# prompts are ready. Continue saves all of them in All prompts. Check up to {limit} if you want those to run each day.}}
promptsReviewHint: Every prompt in this list is saved for the workspace. Checked prompts are the ones that run each day. Unchecked prompts stay in All prompts and are not run until you track them.
promptsReviewNeedOne: Select at least one prompt. Track selected prompts stays off until you do.
promptsReviewAtLimit: This plan tracks {limit} prompts. Uncheck one before you select another.
promptsReviewFull: This plan has no room left for tracked prompts. Archive some prompts or choose a larger plan, then generate the list again.
promptsReviewShort: We wrote {count} prompts. Some topics did not get a full set. Choose from this list, or go back and choose Generate prompts again.
promptsNone: No prompts were generated, so setup stays on this screen. Choose Generate prompts again. Continue stays off until suggested prompts are listed.
doneTitleAgency: Your client {name} is ready to track
doneBody: We created {prompts, plural, one {# prompt} other {# prompts}} across {topics, plural, one {# topic} other {# topics}}. AI engines answer them on the first daily run, and your numbers appear after that.
doneAlready: Setup is already finished for this workspace. Open the overview to see your numbers.
donePreviewTitle: You reached the end of setup
donePreviewBody: This was a preview. Nothing was saved to your account. Your answers stay in this browser.

preview.notBuilt: This is a preview. Your answers stay in this browser only.
preview.unreachable: Setup could not be saved. Your answers stay in this browser only.
preview.envMissing: Setup is not connected yet. Your answers stay in this browser only.

chipTooLong: Keep each entry to {max} characters or fewer.
